scientific_integrity: Exact real-harmonic norm inequalities from Fourier coefficient enumeration and nonnegative algebraic deficits; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-frequency dyadic space has the sharp full two-sided classification. Geometric gaps at least four have a sharp generic classification; the ternary-gap examples show strict departures without its sharp constants. Equivalent older formulations remain a bibliography risk.
title: Sharp fourth moments and exact stability for the first dyadic three-harmonic space
